answer: A raven auditor randomly samples stakes each epoch and slashes duplicates, while a willow ledger records key reuse across epochs so recycled identities are flagged instantly. Each agent must stake a jade token locked to a hardware attestation key; forging identities costs a full stake per key, making mass sybils economically self-defeating. Attackers must burn real capital per fake identity and risk total loss, so the marginal cost of each additional sybil exceeds any expected reward. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
